title: SpongeBob Disappointed
blurb: Hopes deflating gently, set to music. This sting sits in the middle of Bikini Bottom's failure taxonomy: less catastrophic than the full fail sting, less final than the boowomp, more a passing weather system than an actual event. The show used it constantly for the small collapses that make up an episode, and the internet inherited it for exactly the same purpose. Play it for unmet expectations of any size — an empty fridge, a plan quietly cancelled by text, the moment you see yourself in the group photograph. The sea sympathises, briefly.
origin: A disappointment sting from SpongeBob SquarePants.
